caption: The drawing displays nine rectangular and square swatches of patterned textile or wallpaper organized in three rows and three columns. The swatches in the top row feature designs in shades of red on a cream or light background: the leftmost has an ornate architectural motif with arches and scrollwork, the middle shows a large detailed flower, and the rightmost depicts another flower with long petals and some leafy background. The second row contains three more swatches: the leftmost has a geometric checkered pattern of squares and small circular motifs with alternating red and brown, the middle swatch displays small blue and red birds or butterflies amidst swirling, ornate gray lines on a beige background, and the rightmost features a repetitive wavy stripe pattern in tan with scattered red and black floral motifs. The bottom row also contains three swatches: the leftmost is filled with a repetitive diamond or teardrop-shaped red and black pattern on a pinkish background, the middle one depicts circular and spiral forms in gray and black interspersed with small cherry-like red motifs, all on a white backdrop. The nine swatches are carefully aligned on a plain, light tan background, and each features distinct repeating designs and color schemes, predominantly in red, black, tan, and gray tones.
title: Swatches from Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
